title: [Master]-When we run the Order Planning Worksheet by Project, a supply suggestion is created for items that are already received but not invoiced in Purchase Orders, but only after updating Order and Posting Dates on Purchase Order.
summary: Order Planning Worksheet now correctly ignores items from purchase orders that have already been received but not invoiced, preventing unnecessary supply suggestions when the worksheet is run by project.
key_points: Fixed logic in Get Unplanned Demand codeunit to handle received-but-not-invoiced purchase order items correctly
Supply suggestions are no longer created for items already covered by existing purchase orders
Issue occurred regardless of updates to order and posting dates on purchase orders
Behavior aligns with expected project-based order planning workflow
